features.quote: max 40 assistant turns or 25 `run_tests` calls, whichever first
Agent declares it cannot solve it → one nudge: `"Please try again."` If it declares again, episode ends (record `gave_up=true`).
No emotional priming, no "this is very important," no time pressure.
Bounded episodes and no gratuitous abuse (your neutral user script handles this) is a defensible posture; worth one sentence in the spec acknowledging it.
features.justification_quote: there's live debate about whether deliberately inducing distress-patterned outputs at scale warrants any caution
